doc.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Ruth Brown story and everyday racism
summary: Monk recalls Ruth Brown's band; Jackson describes common experiences of racism and dressing to be seen as belonging.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: And it reminds me of the Ruth Brown story. She had a band, they had good cars, and the state troopers just couldn’t understand it, why she would have a good car like that.
Well that’s distressing. I don’t know if you have any thoughts about how that gets changed. How do you legislate a change in attitude, or make people more aware?
